While memory costs are expected to easily be the most expensive component in the iPhone 18 Pro's bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's what we know.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Supply Deal With Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed an exclusive three-year supply deal for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the sole supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its subsequent models," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also mentioned that the panel is "unsurprisingly" one of the device's "most expensive core components."

While there are no reliable details available yet about the iPhone Duo's expected bill of materials cost, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device after breaking down the cost structure of its display, cameras, processors, memory, and other components, including how much of the material is recycled.

As for the actual bill of materials cost of the device, teardown reports and other analyses after it officially goes on sale next month should give us a better idea.
